PREMIUM POURS 
SINGLE MALT SCOTCH 
The Macallan 12 Year Old Double Cask 
The Macallan Double Cask 12 Years Old forms part of our Double Cask range which marries
the classic Macallan style and the unmistakable sweetness of American oak. This is a fully
rounded single malt in perfect balance, with flavours of fudge, citrus and soft spice. 
£7.20 
Lagavulin 16 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky 
Revered by connoisseurs and experts, Lagavulin is known as “the king of Islay”. Aged in oak
casks for at least 16 years, this much sought-after Single Malt has the massive peat-smoke
flavour that's typical of southern Islay, while also offering richness. 
£7.50 
Oban 14 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky 
Nestled on the stunning west coast of Scotland lies the seaside town of Oban. Steeped in history
and legend this wonderful traditional town has its own dedicated distillery. Oban 14 Year Old is
a very much loved single malt that is as traditional as they come, a great coastal dram for lovers
of lightly smoked, fresh malts. 
£7.80 
COGNAC/ARMAGNAC/CALVADOS 
Hennessy XO 
In 1870, Maurice Hennessy created Hennessy X.O. Deep and powerful, the eaux-de-vie of this
Hennessy X.O cognac are aged in young barrels and marked out by their power and energy, but
also by their capacity to achieve a great roundness through time. 
£10.50 
Baron de Sigognac 10 Year Old Armagnac 
The 10 year old Baron de Sigognac delivers an exceptional and rare taste. Mild yet fiery at the
same time like a gently toasted Arabica coffee. The aromas embody a wide range evoking floral
followed by fruity notes yet overall dominated by the sensation of a perfect balance between
fruit and spices. 
£7.50 
PREMIUM POURS 
Sassy Calvados XO 
An excellent Calvados from Château de Sassy, made with its very own cider as the base. The cider itself
has been aged, before being distilled and matured for at least six years. The Calvados is moved to different
barrels twice a year, which helps to oxygenate the spirit, a process that the producer says can help create a
smoother mouth feel. 
£7.50 
AMERICAN 
Whistlepig 10 Year Single Rye Whiskey 
The worlds most awarded rye whiskey. Behind each bottle is over 20 acres of maple trees, which
are used for syrup. It's deliciously complex, with flavours of orange peel, oak, star anise, caramel,
vanilla and butterscotch. 
£7.30 
JAPANESE 
Nikka Whiskey From The Barrel 
Created by blending more than 100 different batches of malt and grain whiskies. After blending,
the whisky is filled into used barrels and matured for another few months. This "marriage" process
harmonizes all components resulting in a mellow taste. 
£6.95 
TEQUILA 
Casamigos Reposado 
Made from 100% Blue Weber agave, this was produced by George Clooney and two friends after
they discovered a shared love of Tequila. Extra-slow fermentation gives it a unique flavour, with
dried fruit, spicy oak and a touch of sweetness. 
£7.50 
Patron Silver 
Patrón Silver is handcrafted from the finest 100% Weber Blue Agave and is carefully distilled in
small batches at Hacienda Patrón distillery in Jalisco, Mexico to create our naturally additive free
super-premium tequila. 
£6.20
